name: Pendle (Router + Market Factory V6)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A real 3-of-5 Safe, reached by two independent on-chain paths that converge on the same address, and that same Safe is the literal SAME contract address as the Pendle Safe already tracked on Robinhood Chain.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80 (pushed on-chain 2026-09-20), identical Safe address, not just same signers
narrative.detail: Every fact here was cross-checked on a second, independent public RPC (thirdweb’s), byte-identical both times. This project’s cross-ecosystem overlap check has found matching signer SETS before, but this is its first-ever hit on the stronger case: the exact same deployed Safe contract, reused across two unrelated chains via CREATE2, so one compromised key set controls both simultaneously. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: crossExposureScore is folded to a flat 80 when the freshly read owner set equals a dated snapshot of Robinhood Chain’s Pendle owner Safe (3-of-5, 5 owners), and stays 100 if the Safe cannot be read or the sets differ. Admin, multisig and timelock are unchanged.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
